goal: `mc deps [<repo>]` answers, in one screen, which of a repository's dependencies need updating and how urgently: npm's outdated and audit readings of the lockfile on `origin/main`, merged per direct dependency into three groups — security fixable within the dependency's major, patch/minor behind, and major behind — each row marked runtime or tool, with the repository's own declared one-line notes (memoro: the wrangler release tally) as their own lines.

`mc deps bump <repo> security|minor|<package>[@<version>]` turns one of those groups into a pull request without anybody touching a checkout: a fresh workarea on `origin/main`, `package.json` and `package-lock.json` changed by npm with `--package-lock-only`, one commit, `mc publish`, then the ordinary `mc merge <repo> <pr>` gate round.
`mc deploy` says the reading in one line before its question — `mc: deps — 2 critical, 24 high; wrangler 4.116.0 → 4.149.0 (33 minor behind; D=2 S=1)` — from what `mc deps` last saved, with its age.

success_criteria.criterion: `mc deps memoro` prints the three groups, the audit counts and the wrangler line for memoro's `origin/main`, and its counts agree with npm's own.
success_criteria.check: Run `mc deps memoro --json --refresh`; its `audit.counts` equals `metadata.vulnerabilities` from `npm audit --json --package-lock-only` run by hand in a directory holding `git -C ~/memoro show origin/main:package.json` and `…:package-lock.json`; `wrangler` appears in `security` (fix `4.149.0` or later) with `kind: "tool"` and `@capacitor/ios` with `kind: "runtime"`; `notes[0].text` starts with `wrangler `. `tests/mc/deps.test.js` green.

success_criteria.criterion: `mc deps bump` makes exactly the lockfile change a group names, in a fresh workarea, and nothing else.
success_criteria.check: `mc deps bump memoro minor --dry-run` prints each `<name> <from> → <to>` it would write and the workarea and branch it would make, and creates neither (`ls ~/mc` and `git -C ~/memoro branch --list 'deps-*'` unchanged). `tests/mc/commands/deps.test.js`: with injected git/npm/publish/merge, a bump calls npm only with `--package-lock-only`, commits only `package.json` and `package-lock.json`, and hands `mc merge` the number `mc publish` returned.

success_criteria.criterion: `mc deploy` shows the deps line from the saved reading, with its age, and says so when there is none.
success_criteria.check: `mc deploy --dry-run` after `mc deps memoro` prints a line starting `mc: deps — ` with the critical and high counts and the wrangler note; with `~/.memoro/mc/deps/memoro.json` moved away it prints `mc: deps not read — mc deps memoro`. `tests/mc/commands/deploy.test.js` green, including a test that `deployPlan` makes no npm or network call for it.

steps.title: `mc deps [<repo>]`: the reading, saved and printed
steps.done_when: `src/mc/deps.js` and `src/mc/commands/deps.js` exist, `deps` is in `VERB_MODULES` and in both help listings in `src/mc/help-text.js`, the memoro entry in `SHIPPED` declares the wrangler note, `normalise` carries `deps_notes`, `mc deps memoro --json --refresh` prints the reading described in the instruction and writes `~/.memoro/mc/deps/memoro.json`, and `tests/mc/deps.test.js` plus `tests/mc/help.test.js` and `tests/mc/repo-gate-table.test.js` are green.
comments: Step 1 (#808): ~/.memoro/mc/repo-gates.json replaces memoro's entry whole, so deps_notes was restated there by hand (with deps_notes_why). For step 3: the reading has an extra 'unread' array (rows whose npm view failed). A major row's 'target' is the newest within its major, and a security row's target is the audit's named fix version (wrangler 4.149.0). sharp is a direct tool dep whose audit fix is wrangler's, so its security target is just in_major.

steps.title: `mc deploy` says the deps line from the saved reading
steps.done_when: `deployPlan` in `src/mc/commands/deploy.js` returns a `deps` field read from `~/.memoro/mc/deps/memoro.json` with no npm or network call, `planLines` prints it as the last line of the reading, `mc deploy --dry-run` shows it, and `tests/mc/commands/deploy.test.js` pins the three cases in the instruction.

steps.title: `mc deps bump <repo> security|minor|<package>[@<version>]`: a lockfile PR through the gate
steps.done_when: `mc deps bump` makes a workarea `deps-<repo>-<what>-<yyyymmdd>` on `origin/main`, changes `package.json`/`package-lock.json` with `--package-lock-only` only, commits, publishes and runs `mc merge <repo> <pr>`; `--dry-run` prints the change and the workarea and makes neither; the help text lists it; and `tests/mc/commands/deps.test.js` pins the cases in the instruction.
